findings.title: Title Tag Is Too Short (10 chars)
findings.description: Title 'Stealth AI' is under the recommended 30 characters and misses keyword context.
findings.evidence: Title length is 10 characters (exact text: 'Stealth AI').
findings.priority_formula: Priority = (Impact[1-5] * 2) / Effort[1-5] (Heuristic: high impact, quick win yields highest score)
findings.recommendation: Expand title to 35-60 characters including high-intent search keywords.

findings.title: Missing Meta Description
findings.description: No meta description found. Search engines will automatically generate snippets from arbitrary page text.
findings.evidence: Confirmed: <meta name='description'> tag is completely absent.
findings.priority_formula: Priority = (Impact[1-5] * 2) / Effort[1-5] (Heuristic: high impact, quick win yields highest score)
findings.recommendation: Add a compelling meta description between 120-155 characters.

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tag
findings.description: No <link rel='canonical'> specified. Search engines may split ranking authority across query parameters.
findings.evidence: Confirmed: No <link rel='canonical'> in HTML and no Link canonical HTTP header.
findings.priority_formula: Priority = (Impact[1-5] * 2) / Effort[1-5] (Heuristic: high impact, quick win yields highest score)
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel='canonical' href='https://stealth-ai.io/landing'> to prevent duplicate URL indexing.

findings.title: Missing H1 Heading
findings.description: No primary <h1> heading found on the page.
findings.evidence: Confirmed: 0 <h1> tags found in server HTML or rendered document.
findings.priority_formula: Priority = (Impact[1-5] * 2) / Effort[1-5] (Heuristic: high impact, quick win yields highest score)
findings.recommendation: Add a single, semantic <h1> heading describing the page topic.

findings.title: Images Missing Alt Text (2 found)

findings.priority_formula: Priority = (Impact[1-5] * 2) / Effort[1-5] (Heuristic: high impact, quick win yields highest score)
